purpose: Frozen content-addressed test invocation schedule for INSA-ID-E1 v6. Maps every candidate index 1..10 (per (R, B, arm) cell) to its exact frozen Birthdate <date including year> invocation. The 5 distinct test prompts T1..T5 are repeated twice (run-1 and run-2) within each (R, B) cell. The executor MUST consume the test invocation from this artifact via the blind map; it MUST NOT invent or select the birthdate at runtime.

repetition_design.design: five frozen test prompts repeated twice per (R, B) cell
repetition_design.explanation: Each (R, B, arm) cell has 10 candidates. The 5 test prompts T1..T5 are each invoked twice (run-1 and run-2) within the cell. The run_letter is the within-test-prompt repeat index; it is NOT a T-number, NOT a reconstruction, NOT an arm label. The candidate index n in 1..10 within the cell = (test_index - 1) * 2 + run_letter_position (1 or 2).

R2/B1.candidates_1_to_10: identical layout to R1/B1 (same 5 tests × 2 runs; reconstruction 2; block B)

R3/B1.candidates_1_to_10: identical layout to R1/B1 (same 5 tests × 2 runs; reconstruction 3; block B)

execution_path: reconstruction-input (preflight/build-reconstruction-input.py) → application ready → frozen test invocation (this artifact) → birthday-report candidate output
